Chapter 9: Lessons in Friendship and Creativity—What the Inklings Teach Us Now
When you think about the Inklings, it’s easy to picture them as these almost mythical figures—extraordinary talents, maybe even untouchable. But the truth is, underneath all that, they were just regular people. They had the same doubts, the same dreams, and the same struggles that you and I face every day.
Their story isn’t about some rare spark of genius. It’s about friendship, about courage, and about sticking with your craft even when nothing seems certain.
Picture someone right now, maybe it’s you, sitting at a messy desk, wrestling with a stubborn idea or staring at a half-finished story. Giving up? It can feel so tempting—especially when it seems like the world couldn’t care less, or worse, is rooting against you. But here’s where the Inklings show us another way.
Creativity doesn’t have to be a solo act. In fact, for the Inklings, it never was. Their secret? They leaned on each other. They challenged one another and gave honest feedback—but never crossed that line into cruelty. They celebrated each other’s wins without a hint of jealousy. And when things went sideways, they forgave, picked up the pieces, and started again, together.
Most folks don’t realize just how much guts it takes to share a messy first draft—or how much gentle encouragement is needed to help someone else find their voice. But the Inklings got it. They knew that creativity, at its core, is a group effort.
The stories that last? They’re the ones shaped and polished by many hands, challenged by different minds, and fueled by genuine care.
When it comes down to it, the magic happens not in isolation, but in community. It’s about coming together—listening, asking questions, dreaming big and small. That’s where the real difference is made.
So, if you’re out there feeling alone on your creative journey, remember what the Inklings taught us. You don’t have to go it alone. Sometimes, the very best ideas—and the courage to keep going—come from the people who walk alongside you.
